Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era

Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition

description:
Vintage Vest Pocket Smoking Pipe
Folding Swiveling Stem Estate Pipe
Carved Wood & Metal, Approximately 5.25 Inches
Designed for portability and discreet carry, the vest pocket pipe originated in the early-to-mid 20th century as a compact travel alternative to standard tobacco pipes. Featuring an oval, low-profile bowl and a rotating stem mechanism, this functional design folds flat to easily slip into a waistcoat or jacket pocket without creating bulk.
Carved textured wood stummel with an oval chamber designed for compact carry
Rotating swivel stem design that aligns flush with the bowl for pocket storage
Polished metal ferrule band joining the shank and mouthpiece
Dark stem accented with an inlaid spade emblem
Condition:
Pre-owned estate condition. The bowl chamber exhibits visible carbon buildup and char from prior use. The exterior wood finish displays natural grain wear, surface darkening, and light handling marks. The metal band shows minor surface patina, and the stem retains its shape with slight surface oxidation and light handling wear near the bit.

Trilobite Fossil Lot - 5 Pieces
Paleontological Specimen Collection
Natural Stone Matrix, 1.5 to 9.5 Inches
This five-piece collection features an assortment of trilobite fossil specimens preserved in stone matrix, highlighted by a large prepared display plaque displaying a central trilobite relief. Trilobites were prominent marine arthropods of the Paleozoic Era, making these specimens iconic additions to fossil and mineral collections.
5 distinct stone specimens ranging in size from 1.5 inches to 9.5 inches
Large prepared oval plaque featuring raised articulated trilobite anatomy and chiseled matrix border
Four stone nodules and slabs featuring partial trilobite casts and exoskeleton impressions

Descriptions are made by individuals who may not have expertise specific to this type of item, in consultation with local and Internet resources. Shoppers are cautioned to evaluate items based upon their own resources. No guarantee of authenticity is implied unless specifically stated.
How Photography Affects Size Perception
Macro (extreme close-up) photography is heavily utilized in jewelry listings, enabling viewers to examine pieces in larger-than-life detail. An accurate understanding of the actual sizes of these pieces cannot be deduced using photos alone. It is important that the bidder takes close note of the measurements and weights to determine actual sizes.
About Gemstone & Metal Testing
Gemstones are tested with a Presidium Gem Tester. Goodwill of the Olympics & Rainier Region is a member of the International Gem Society; however, as we are not certified gemologists, we cannot guarantee the authenticity of any gemstone unless otherwise stated. Gemstone identification information is provided for your reference and consideration in bidding; no guarantee is implied.
Pearls are tested with a check for grittiness to detect nacre irregularities. We are generally unable to specify pearl types and characteristics; they may be cultured, wild, freshwater or saltwater pearls. Coral may be natural or dyed; most of our coral listings include dyed pieces.
Metals including Gold, Silver, and Platinum are tested using an XRF precious metal analyzer, the Niton XL2 by Thermo Scientific, unless explicitly noted otherwise. XRF (X-ray fluorescence) analysis is a non-destructive testing method able to determine an item's elemental composition. Identification of other non-magnetic metals, including brass, bronze, copper, tin, and titanium, rely on our best estimation, and no guarantee is implied; they have not been tested or positively identified unless explicitly noted otherwise. Some jewelry may contain non-precious metals in clasps or findings, causing parts of the piece to respond to a magnet.
Collections

Many pieces have unspecified condition issues. Please view provided photographs to determine general contents. No part of such groupings may be returned for any reason.
Condition descriptions for pieces present in scrap lots are not available and many pieces may have unspecified condition issues. Flaws may include missing stones, broken clasps, broken chains, bent or dented metal, repairs, and other damage. A.T. Cross Writing Instruments

Items Included:
Ballpoint Pen (Green Case) - Gold-tone fluted metal casing with black conical top accent and pocket clip marked CROSS

Two original Cross hard-shell presentation cases with satin lid linings and fitted velour trays

Vintage Novelty & Accessory Lot - 3 Carded Packages
Target / Dayton Hudson Corp, Retro Collectibles
Circa 1980s-1990s

These blister-carded products represent everyday retail novelties of the late 20th century, retaining their original retail packaging and pricing.

Target 7-Piece Accessory Set - Purple plastic headband, 2 hair combs, 2 cascade clips, and 2 ponyholders on original grid card

shipping.policy:
All shippable items are shipped by dimensional weight. Dimensional weight is calculated by the carrier based on the amount of cubic space an item requires for transport, and may be higher than the actual item weight.
Shipping:
All items are typically shipped within five business days (Monday through Friday, excluding major holidays) following the date of purchase. We do NOT offer any shipping options faster than FedEx Ground.
Please contact us prior to making payment if there are specific shipping requirements or requests such as signature confirmation or insurance.
Additional charges may apply.
We do not, under any circumstances, accept pre-paid shipping labels provided by customers.
Please contact us with any questions or concerns regarding shipping prior to paying.
Combined Shipping:
Items eligible for combined shipping may be combined at the time of payment. If an item is already paid for, it may not be combined with an unpaid item.

description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray, Ohio Valley Glass Co. (O.V.G. Co.)
Aqua and Teal Green, Vintage
Collection of three vintage glass insulators originally utilized for telegraph and telephone line insulation. This lot features insulators from prominent American manufacturers, showcasing the industrial aqua and teal green glass common to early 20th-century utility production. These heavy pressed glass pieces are sought after for their historical industrial aesthetic and display appeal.
Pieces Included:
Insulator, Aqua, marked "O.V.G. CO." - features a large chip on the side and base
Insulator, Teal Green, marked "N 21" - internal vertical crack visible on the crown
Insulator, Aqua/Teal, marked "HEMINGRAY" - exhibits surface scratching and minor flea bites
Condition:
The lot is in damaged vintage condition as noted and photographed. One insulator has a significant chip loss on the lower body. A second piece shows a distinct crack through the glass dome. The Hemingray piece retains its shape but shows signs of outdoor weathering and light surface wear. Recommended for rustic decor or craft projects.

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

shipping.policy:
Use the Estimate Shipping link on any item page before placing a bid to get the estimated cost.
We ship exclusively FedEx and cannot ship to a P.O. Box or APO/FPO/DPO addresses.
We know you are eager to receive your item once it has been paid for; however, we hope you understand that everyone wants their purchase quickly. To be fair, we only ship in the order payment was received. We are determined to ship all items within six (6) business days of purchase, and except during the end-of-year holiday season are usually able to ship in less than five (5) business days. To help us get your item to you sooner, here are a few things you can do:
1)
If you want items to ship together, they must be combined at checkout.
Items must be similar in size and shape and the combined weight must be less than 20 pounds. If we feel items cannot be safely shipped together, we will not allow combining.
2) Once paid for, items cannot be combined.
3) Worried about porch thieves? FedEx has thousands of retail locations, including many Walgreens, to which packages can be delivered.
We strongly recommend this; if the package is lost or stolen and FedEx denies the claim, no refund can be given.
You can search on FedEx.com for a location near you and use that for your Ship To address (before making payment) or contact us with the address immediately after making payment. You will need to have a photo ID to pick it up at the location you selected and must pick up within 5 days of its arrival. A package not picked up will be returned to us; when we receive it, we will post a refund of the purchase price and relist it.
For security purposes, we will only change an address to a secure FedEx pick up location address after payment has been made. No other address change will be made once payment has processed.
4) Items will not be dismantled for any reason; no exceptions.
5) Shipping charges cannot be added to a paid order.
FedEx includes insurance for the order purchase price and shipping cost up to $100.
All orders over $100 will be shipped requiring a signature,
unless being shipped to a designated FedEx pick-up location.
If you would like to add signature requested delivery or additional insurance, just click
Contact Seller
near the top of the item's auction page prior to making payment.
There is an additional charge and we cannot add charges to a paid order.

When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.

cannot be adjusted or discounted

description:
Natural Purple Amethyst Cluster
Mineral Geode Specimen with Cut Flat Base
Natural Amethyst Quartz, 5 Inches Tall, 1.6 lbs
This natural purple amethyst crystal geode cluster specimen features a dense formation of sparkling crystalline quartz points lining an interior cavity. Characterized by rich violet tones, the formation exhibits concentric agate and quartz matrix banding along its natural rock rind. Cut with a level base, it stands freely for upright presentation as an earth science specimen, altar stone, or display accent.
Naturally formed amethyst quartz crystal points in rich violet hues
Natural outer rock matrix rind showcasing surrounding agate banding
Cut flat base allows for stable, upright tabletop or shelf display
Measures approximately 5 inches tall, 4 inches long, 3 inches wide; weighs 1.6 lbs
Condition:
Natural geological specimen with inherent crystal matrix variations, natural terminations, and rough rock textures. No artificial repairs or synthetic coatings observed. Cut base is stable and sits flat for upright display.

description:
Natural Petrified Wood Slab Tray
Fossilized Wood Footed Trivet / Display Plaque
Natural History Specimen, Mid to Late 20th Century
This substantial petrified wood slab is cut from an authentic fossilized tree round, showcasing a mirror-polished top surface that reveals intricate concentric growth rings and vivid mineral crystallization. The stone exhibits a rich spectrum of natural tones including deep brick red, warm amber, ochre yellow, and smoky charcoal. The natural outer circumference retains its rough, textured bark-like matrix, while the underside is fitted with four applied pedestal feet for elevated tabletop use as a decorative tray, trivet, or mineral display.
Authentic petrified wood slab with high-gloss polished upper surface
Natural rugged chert/bark perimeter displaying organic texture and matrix
Underside fitted with four molded feet for stable tabletop elevation
Measures approximately 9 inches long by 8 inches wide by 2 inches high; weighs 7.6 lbs
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. The polished surface displays bright luster with natural geological fractures, pit lines, and crystalline seams characteristic of ancient mineralized wood. Natural rough variation and earthy texture along the unpolished outer edge. Feet are securely attached to the underside with minor age-appropriate scuffing.

You are purchasing a "Mixed Rock and Mineral Collection Lot with Agate Slices" in "Used" condition.
Colorful mixed lot of rocks, minerals, and agate slices—perfect for collectors, crafters, educators, or anyone who loves natural stone. This unique bundle includes a wide variety of pieces, from rough rock specimens to polished tumbled stones and vibrant agate slices. You’ll see multiple shapes, sizes, and colors, along with a bag of mixed stones and a small display box of polished pieces. There is also a rectangular stone block with an animal outline and a printed information card for a Brazilian agate piece. Whether you tumble rocks, wire-wrap jewelry, teach geology, or just enjoy displaying interesting stones, this lot gives you an instant, varied collection with plenty to sort, study, and use in projects. Highlights: - Assorted tumbled stones in multiple colors - Rough rocks and mineral pieces with natural texture - Several polished agate slices in bright and neutral tones - One stone display box with polished stones - One larger stone block with an animal outline and info card - One bag filled with mixed stones for sorting or crafting Great for rock enthusiasts, classroom kits, craft projects, or decorating bowls, terrariums, and shelves. Keywords: rock collection, mixed stones lot, tumbled stones, agate slices, mineral specimens, rock hound, geology kit, craft stones, decorative rocks
Condition Notes:
Mixed lot of assorted rocks, minerals, and tumbled stones with visible handling wear. Some rough stones have chipped edges and natural surface irregularities. Tumbled stones appear generally smooth with minor scuffs. Agate slices show clean cuts with some edge wear and small surface scratches. The plastic display box has light surface wear and small marks. The bag of mixed stones shows no visible tears but is creased from handling. The carved rectangular stone block and other larger pieces show small nicks and surface scratches consistent with age and use.

Natural Agate Geode Half Specimen with Quartz Crystal Center Bookend Pair
Natural agate geode specimen cut in half, revealing crystalline interior with banded gray, white, and purple agate layers surrounding a hollow quartz crystal center. Exterior has rough, unpolished dark gray/brown stone crust, retaining original nodule surface. Two matching halves fit together, commonly used as bookends or display specimens. Banding pattern shows concentric rings of translucent white quartz crystals transitioning to grayish-purple agate, with small hints of green mineral near center. Specimen is in good condition with no visible chips or damage to crystalline surfaces, suitable for mineral collectors or home decor.

title: Hemingray 42 Glass Insulator Set 2 Aqua Blue Green CD 154 Made in USA Vintage
description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Condition:
Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.

Hand-Carved Wooden Figurine
Man Smoking Pipe Folk Art Sculpture
Carved Solid Wood, 28 Inches
This hand-carved wooden folk art sculpture depicts a standing bearded man wearing a wide-brimmed hat and rustic attire, smoking a pipe and carrying a curved horn. Rendered from solid wood, the piece features expressive facial carving, rhythmic gouge work, and contrasting dark-stained accents that highlight the organic grain and textures of the timber. Large-scale figurative carvings of this style reflect traditional vernacular woodworking traditions and make compelling additions to rustic, global, or folk art collections.
Hand-carved solid timber construction with chiseled gouge details
Depicts a standing elder figure with pipe, brimmed hat, and shoulder strap
Natural warm wood tone accented with black-stained detailing
Integrated round pedestal base carved from the same solid block
Condition:
Structurally intact and stable on base. Natural age checking and drying cracks are visible on the hat brim and base underside, typical of solid wood carvings. Minor surface finish wear and light dust in recesses. No detached pieces or structural breaks.
